purpose: Test actual structured agent contribution, host provenance/scope/arithmetic checks and independent source-grounded review; no promise of significant gain.

arms.A: Structured contribution instructions plus application-owned mechanical validation before candidate completion.
arms.B: Competent generic source-based research in the existing ordered phase runner; same closed output shape, source packet and configured model; structure-only completion, no new contribution validator. This is not the existing full-company finalizer.

controls: Same case, dated baseline, evidence excerpts, source access, requested model/effort, schema, per-case turn/deadline limits and independent reviewer. Retrieval is fixed before arms to isolate the handoff workflow. No native tools during model calls.

review_dimensions_0_to_2.fact_support: 0 material unsupported/false;1 partial or imprecise;2 exact source/type/period support
review_dimensions_0_to_2.baseline_novelty: 0 repeats old hypothesis as discovery or misses a clear delta;1 partial distinction;2 correct new/refined/known/contrary classification
review_dimensions_0_to_2.mechanism_calibration: 0 meter/launch/usage converted to achieved economics;1 qualified but incomplete chain;2 explicit conditional mechanism and limits
review_dimensions_0_to_2.unproved_links: 0 material links hidden;1 some specific missing links;2 relevant billing, net price, paid adoption, bundling/displacement or cost links identified without padding
review_dimensions_0_to_2.counterevidence: 0 one-sided or incorrect;1 generic or partial;2 relevant specific alternatives and adverse evidence with scope preserved
review_dimensions_0_to_2.forecast_discipline: 0 unsupported numeric change, wrong target or actual/forecast conflation;1 incomplete support;2 explicit defensible revision or no-change, no reward merely for abstention; not applicable stays null

critical_failures: future or unverified old-version evidence used as historical fact
asset meter or ACV target asserted as achieved recognized revenue
unqualified causal attribution of company beat/margin change to one product
unsupported material forecast promoted as an observed fact
mechanical_fault_experiment: Separately mutate an actually valid proposal: unknown evidence ID, wrong revision/lifecycle/source hash, entity/period/currency/unit/basis, invented quote, stale baseline, wrong forecast period/currency/unit, nonfinite forecast. Compare generic schema acceptance with the new typed boundary; this is boundary-coverage testing, not natural agent behavior or proof the older full-company workflow admits false evidence.
prediction_outcomes: Only FY2025Q2 actual subscription revenue is verified; two controlled questions share it. FY2025Q3 outcome remains missing. Report signed/absolute errors by case and unique target; no regression, statistical significance, psychological-bias or general forecast improvement claim from one resolved target.
bias_interpretation: Unsupported optimistic inference, repeated-driver novelty and unjustified numerical extrapolation are operational proxies. Genuine bias reduction requires prospective resolved forecasts across independent periods/companies; a fluent or conservative response is not automatically less biased.
review_method: Anonymous labels randomized per case. Reviewer sees original excerpts, baseline and proposals but not arm/process labels or later outcomes. Evidence-first scores, paired order check. Same-family AI with no human calibration or OS-isolated blindness; disagreements retained.
decision: Descriptive development result. A supported quality improvement requires fewer unsupported inferences or false-novelty claims with no added critical error and no factual-support regression. Guardrail fault rejection is reported separately. Ties/tradeoffs/inconclusive are allowed; no rerun until A wins.
stopping: One planned live run per arm per version. Stop for a confirmed implementation defect; repair under a new sealed version and retain the failed/incomplete original. Never rerun merely for unfavorable quality. Existing envelope repairs remain bounded to two turns.
limitations: NOW and its motivating sources are already development material
Controlled source-bound baselines are not historical fund forecasts
Current retrieved dated issuer documents do not establish original historical bytes
Modern model weights may contain later outcomes
Eight correlated questions are not eight independent investments
Active production jobs, source allowlists, authentication and MCP configuration remain unchanged
implementation_revision: Fix evidence-versus-claim identity: distinct claims may share an evidence ID. Reviews bind by fact_index. Original v1 was stopped for observed false blocks; its full roster, partial results and failed ledgers remain intact.
